items.title: Using Quantifiers in Logical Statements (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Using Quantifiers in Logical Statements with a self-check and a small all()/any() program of ours (PDF 32, printed 28).

blocks.text: Quantifiers ko predicates ke saath mila kar saaf logical statements bante hain. Maslan “∀x, P(x)” ka matlab hai predicate P(x) har x ke liye sach hai, jabke “∃x, P(x)” ka matlab hai P(x) kam az kam ek x ke liye sach hai. Quantifiers mushkil statements mein ek saath bhi aa sakte hain. Maslan “∀x ∃y, x < y” ka matlab hai har x ke liye koi aisa y maujood hai jo x se bara ho. Quantifiers se qaide, shartein aur rishte saaf likhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Quantifier ki shakal mein likhein: (a) Class ka har student pass hua. (b) Class ke kisi student ne poore marks liye.

blocks.text: Python ke all() aur any() functions quantifiers jaisa kaam karte hain: all() “for all” (∀) hai aur any() “there exists” (∃). numbers ki list badal kar dekhein.

numbers = [2, 4, 6, 7]   # domain: jin cheezon ki baat ho rahi hai

for_all_positive = all(x > 0 for x in numbers)        # for all x, x > 0
exists_even = any(x % 2 == 0 for x in numbers)        # there exists x, x is even
for_all_even = all(x % 2 == 0 for x in numbers)       # for all x, x is even

print("For all x, x > 0:", for_all_positive)
print("There exists an even x:", exists_even)
print("For all x, x is even:", for_all_even)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"numbers = [2, 4, 6, 7]": domain, yani woh cheezein jin ki baat ho rahi hai.
"all(x > 0 for x in numbers)": har x ke liye x > 0 check karta hai; sab sach hon tabhi True. Yeh ∀x, x > 0 hai.
"any(x % 2 == 0 for x in numbers)": kam az kam ek even number ho to True. Yeh ∃x, x is even hai.
"all(x % 2 == 0 for x in numbers)": kya har number even hai? 7 even nahi, is liye False.
Output: "For all x, x > 0: True", "There exists an even x: True" aur "For all x, x is even: False".
Khud try karein: numbers = [1, 3, 5] likhein: pehli line True, doosri False (koi even nahi) aur teesri False. Phir numbers = [2, 4, 6]: teeno True.

items: ∀x, P(x): P har x ke liye sach; ∃x, P(x): kam az kam ek x ke liye sach.
Dono ek saath: ∀x ∃y, x < y (har x se bara koi y hai).
